quests.title: One corner, on its own
quests.ask: Fill in `go_around_corner()`: from the start of a side, walk to the corner, pick its gem, and end one step along the next side, facing along it.
quests.nudge: This block is bigger than last time. How far is it to the corner now?

quests.title: Two corners in a row
quests.ask: Use `go_around_corner()` on the real block so the robot clears the first corner and then the one below it.
quests.nudge: Where one call ends is where the next one starts. Is that the start of a side?

quests.title: Let a loop call it
quests.ask: Instead of writing a call for every corner, let a `for` loop make the calls to `go_around_corner()`.
quests.nudge: Every corner is the same job. What changes from one call to the next?

quests.title: All the way home
quests.ask: Go round the whole block, picking every corner, and finish where you started, facing east.
quests.nudge: How many corners does the block have, and what does each round do?
